buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Service provider will be liable for ensuring compliance with the provision of all applicable laws specially workmen compensation act, EPF Laws, ESI Laws, Income Tax Laws, Minimum wages Laws, Con tract labou r (Regulations & Abolition) Act and any other relevant Acts as may become applicable during the tenure of the contract. 2. The onus of compliance to all the applicable Laws/Acts / Rules shall rest with the service provider only a nd the buyer will not be liable in any manner. The service provider shall make his own engagement of all t he workmen, local or otherwise, and for their transport, housing, feeding and payment. 3. Service provider must provide required tools, equipments and safety gears based on applicable regulati on / Codes/ guidelines. 4 Service provider shall be personally responsible for any theft, misconduct and disobedience on the part o f personnel deployed by them. 5 Service provider has to arrange all consumable like detergent, cloth, soap bar, duster etc and will ensure cleanliness of the E&M equipments. Service provider required to personally visit the site of work and get hi mself acquainted about the details of the installation. 6 The duty hours/ chart has to be decided/ finalized by the agency in consultation with AE(E), CCW Akashv ani. All equipments and installations shall be maintained in neat and clean condition. The watch and ward of installations shall be responsibility of the agency. The agency shall be responsible for safe custody of all the system and its various components/ materials during contract period. In case of any t heft or any loss t o the Government property is noticed, it shall be recovered from the agency. Assessment of loss shall be d ecided by Engineer-in-charge and hi s decision in this regard shall be final and binding on the agency. 7. The contractor has to maintain the complaint register, log books, maintenance records and registers for each of the E&M installation the agency has to arrange T&P required for the work at site. No tools and plan ts shall be supplied by the department. The contractor shall be responsible for arrangement and safe cust ody of their tools at site. 8. Dismantled materials received from site after replacement of materials supplied by the department shall be handed over to Assistant Engineer [E]-P, in charge of the the work. 9. Monthly payment shall only be made after satisfactory completion of work and after sub mission of Biom etric attendance sheet & copy of wage register duly singed by the agency and AE & AE(P). 10. Agency shall make the monthly wages & allowances to their deployed staff through ECS/ NEFT/RTGS in to their bank account. All contractual staff shall be paid not less than the minimum wages notified by Gove rnment of NCT, Delhi from time to time. 11. Safety of the staff employed will be the responsibility of the agency that must insure the staff adequat ely. The department CCW: Akashvani will not be responsible for any mishap, injury/ death of the staff. 12. The agency shall submit the name, address, Aadhar card Copy & police verification of the worker/ Staff employed by them at the site of work to the engineer in charge before start of the work. 13. The staff has to wear set of uniforms with name plate which is to be provided by the contractor for whi ch no extra cost shall be payable by the department. 14. Site is a secured and sensitive installation and all the operating and maintenance staff will have to follo w all securities rules and regulation. In case of any contractual staff found to b e no courteous, indiscipline and indulged in any misconduct, agency will have to remove such staff from site and will have to provide his substitute within 3 days failing which, the Engineer In-Charge has the power to cancel the contract, and the agency shall have no claim of compensation. 15. The Executive Engineer [E] shall have the option to terminate the contract at his discretion at any time without assigning any reason, by giving notice as per CPWD works Manual, and no claim of the agency sha ll be entertained. 16. Recovery will be made at the double of wages in case of not attending the duties by the personnel of t he service provider.

17. List of Documents to be Uploaded on GeM Portal required for Pre-qualification of Agencies: 1. GST registration Certificate. 2. Latest GST return. 3. EPFO & ESI Registration certificate. 4.Turnover certificate audited by CA for last three financial year, (turnover should be minimum Average of 3 times the estimated cost). 5. Valid Electrical License of the agency issued from State/ Central authorized Govt. Department. 6. Valid Enlistment of the contractor (From CPWD and those appropriate list of MES, BSNL, Railways and Pu blic Works Department Delhi) 7. Proof of agency having registered office in Delhi / NCR. 8. Affidavit on the stamp paper of Rs. 100/- duly notarized stating that:- “I/ We undertake and confirm that eligible similar works(s) has / have not been got executed through anot her contractor on back to back basis. (b) I/We will pay minimum wages to the employed staff as per Govt. of NCT Delhi. (c) There is no criminal case against me /us agency 9. Completion Certificate as detailed below:- Three similar completed works of aggregate cost not less than 40% of estimated cost (Rs. 7,60,000/-) of a bove work OR Two similar completed works of aggregate cost not less than 60% (Rs. 11,40,000/-) of estim ated cost of above work OR one similar completed work of aggregate cost not less than 80%(Rs.15,00,000 /-) of the estimated cost of above work in Central or State Government/ Central or State Government Unde rtaking/ Central or State Government Autonomous Body. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PB BCI EEE-II CCW AIR New Delhi payable at New Delhi . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of PB BCI EEE-II CCW AIR New Delhi payable at New Delhi . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date.
